SELECT T1.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / T1.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T2.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT T2.School
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT T1.CustomerID
FROM customers AS T1
INNER JOIN yearmonth AS T2 ON T1.CustomerID = T2.CustomerID
WHERE T1.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
ORDER BY T2.Consumption ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM (
    SELECT y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) < 30000
);

SELECT player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes
ORDER BY overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' AND l.status = 'C';

SELECT CASE
           WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
           ELSE '1996'
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM member 
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id 
WHERE major.college = 'Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.link_to_member)
FROM attendance AS T1
JOIN event AS T2 ON T1.link_to_event = T2.event_id
WHERE T2.event_name = "Women's Soccer";

SELECT T1.full_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
GROUP BY T1.id, T1.full_name
HAVING COUNT(T2.power_id) > 15;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS chlorine_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';

SELECT (frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0) / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON schools.CDSCode = frpm.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOC = 66
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT T2.School
FROM schools AS T2
INNER JOIN satscores AS T1 ON T2.CDSCode = T1.cds
WHERE T1.NumTstTakr > 500 AND T2.Magnet = 1

SELECT DisplayName
FROM users
ORDER BY Views DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT c.CustomerID
FROM customers c
JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
WHERE c.Segment = 'LAM'
  AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2012'
GROUP BY c.CustomerID
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_customers
FROM (
    SELECT y.CustomerID
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Segment = 'KAM'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201201 AND 201212
    GROUP BY y.CustomerID
    HAVING SUM(y.Consumption) < 30000
);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes);

SELECT player_name, height
FROM Player
ORDER BY height DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM account 
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague' 
AND account.account_id NOT IN (SELECT account_id FROM loan);

SELECT CASE
         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
         ELSE '1996'
       END AS higher_unemployment_year
FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
GROUP BY s.id
HAVING COUNT(s.full_name) > 15;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero INNER JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue';

SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS inpatient_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS outpatient_count,
  CASE
    WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'in-patient'
    ELSE 'outpatient'
  END AS more_common,
  CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
  SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient
WHERE SEX = 'M';

SELECT bond_type
FROM bond
GROUP BY bond_type
ORDER BY COUNT(bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.molecule_id) AS num_molecules
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';
